purpose: Operator-tunable competition scoring order and bounded recovery
notes: Competition actions retry automatically up to the configured bound and continue to the next eligible part after a clean failure. A possible held-part state remains a hard stop. Reorder this list only after physical evidence. Menu option 8 reloads this file while the menu is running.
pick_only_note: Pick-only actions retain the part and cannot be chained across parts. Use them for individual validation; the scoring plan uses pick_place so the hand is freed for the next part.
